jurisdictions.name: Germany
jurisdictions.accessBodyRole: Datenzugangs- und Koordinierungsstelle für Gesundheitsdaten (§ 3 GDNG); nach dem Entwurf des GeDIG die koordinierende Zugangsstelle für Gesundheitsdaten
jurisdictions.accessBodyRoleEn: Health data access and coordination body (section 3 GDNG); under the GeDIG bill, the coordinating health data access body, with domain-specific access bodies beside it
jurisdictions.designationStatus: Not designated under Art. 55 yet. The GeDIG bill makes the coordinating access body the Art. 55(1) body and coordinator and the Art. 75(1) national contact point; it is before the Bundestag.
jurisdictions.optOutModel: Today: data from the electronic patient record (ePA) reach the research data centre unless the person objects (section 363 SGB V); the objection can be limited to purposes. Under the GeDIG bill: a central register for the rights of data subjects takes the objection under Art. 71, for all purposes or some, from age 15.
jurisdictions.fees: Charged today: the research data centre charges under the Datentransparenz fee ordinance (DaTraGebV). Under the GeDIG bill the access bodies charge fees under Art. 62, set by ordinance of the health ministry.
jurisdictions.summary: Germany has a health data use act since 2024 and a research data centre that takes applications. The bill that implements the EHDS (GeDIG) re-enacts that act, creates a coordinating access body and domain-specific ones, and a central register for objections.

jurisdictions.name: Austria
jurisdictions.accessBodyRole: Zugangsstelle für Gesundheitsdaten (noch nicht gesetzlich geregelt)
jurisdictions.accessBodyRoleEn: Health data access body (not yet set out in law)
jurisdictions.designationStatus: Not designated, and no implementation bill found. A national preparation project for secondary use (HealthData@AT) runs from 2023 to the end of 2027.
jurisdictions.optOutModel: Today there is no objection specific to secondary use: the ELGA opt-out, general or partial, concerns the electronic health record and primary use. Research access to registers rests on the Research Organisation Act. The Art. 71 opt-out is still to be set out.
jurisdictions.fees: Research access to statistical micro data through the micro data centre is charged at cost, per project and for use and storage. No fee rule under Art. 62 yet.
jurisdictions.summary: Austria opens federal registers and statistical micro data for research under its Research Organisation Act and the Federal Statistics Act. The EHDS access body and its law are still being prepared.

jurisdictions.name: Belgium
jurisdictions.accessBodyRole: coördinerende instantie voor toegang tot gezondheidsgegevens / organisme responsable de l'accès aux données de santé (gepland / prévu)
jurisdictions.accessBodyRoleEn: Coordinating health data access body (planned): the agency set up by the law of 14 March 2023, as an interfederal institution, with the information security committee granting permits
jurisdictions.designationStatus: Not designated. The designation awaits political approval at inter-ministerial level; the law that will implement the EHDS follows once the governance is settled.
jurisdictions.optOutModel: No general objection to secondary use in the current law; reuse is decided case by case by the information security committee under the GDPR. The Art. 71 opt-out is still to be set out.
jurisdictions.fees: The law of 14 March 2023 (Art. 11) lets the agency charge applicants, the amount set by royal decree.
jurisdictions.summary: Belgium created a health data agency by the law of 14 March 2023, to make health data findable and reusable. Its role as the coordinating EHDS access body is planned, across the federal state and the communities, in Dutch, French and German.

jurisdictions.name: France
jurisdictions.accessBodyRole: Plateforme des données de santé (art. L1462-1 du code de la santé publique)
jurisdictions.accessBodyRoleEn: Health data platform, a public interest group created by the 2019 health system act (Public Health Code, Art. L1462-1)
jurisdictions.designationStatus: Not designated. The EHDS is to be implemented through the bill adapting French law to EU law (DDADUE), which the Senate adopted on 18 February 2026 without an EHDS article yet; it is before the National Assembly.
jurisdictions.optOutModel: Today a person can object to the reuse of their data from the national health data system (SNDS) for research, through the platform or their health insurance fund; the objection does not reach every processing of public bodies. How France will use the Art. 71(4) exception is not yet in a published text.
jurisdictions.fees: Charged: the platform may charge for access, free in the cases the Public Health Code sets out, and harmonised fee grids were approved by the strategic committee for health data in February 2025.
jurisdictions.summary: France has the national health data system (SNDS) and, since 2019, a health data platform that gives access to it for projects of public interest. The EHDS is to come in through the DDADUE bill.

jurisdictions.name: Netherlands
jurisdictions.accessBodyRoleEn: Health data authority, a new independent administrative body proposed by the Health Information System bill; it would be the Art. 55(1) access body, the Art. 75(1) contact point and the digital health authority of Art. 19
jurisdictions.designationStatus: Not designated. The bill (first tranche) went to internet consultation from 27 May to 8 July 2026; the authority is to be operational by 26 March 2029.
jurisdictions.optOutModel: Today data go to research without consent only under strict conditions and if the patient has not objected (Civil Code Art. 7:458). The Art. 71 opt-out and the permit procedure follow in the second tranche of the bill.
jurisdictions.fees: Not set out yet; the first tranche of the bill does not cover fees.
jurisdictions.summary: The Netherlands builds a new health data authority from scratch. The Health Information System bill sets it up in two tranches: the authority first, then the opt-out, the permits and the rules for secondary use.

jurisdictions.name: Spain
jurisdictions.accessBodyRole: organismo nacional de acceso a datos de salud, que coordina los organismos regionales de acceso a datos de salud (propuesto)
jurisdictions.accessBodyRoleEn: National health data access body coordinating regional health data access bodies in the autonomous communities (proposed)
jurisdictions.designationStatus: Not designated. The Digital Health Act that adapts Spanish law to the Regulation is a pre-draft; its prior public consultation ran from 22 September to 20 October 2025, and it was not yet approved by the Council of Ministers.
jurisdictions.optOutModel: No general objection to secondary use today: health research rests on broad consent, compatible reuse after an ethics committee or pseudonymised data (Organic Law 3/2018, seventeenth additional provision); the GDPR right to object applies. The Art. 71 opt-out is still to be set out.
jurisdictions.fees: No national fee schedule; the pre-draft is to set the fee regime.
jurisdictions.summary: Spain plans a national access body that coordinates the regional ones, since health care is run by the autonomous communities. The Digital Health Act that implements the EHDS is in preparation.
